AKI_SISTER_POWER_DRAIN_POWER.description:
Creatures afflicted with [gold]Decay[/gold] deal [blue]15%[/blue] less attack damage.
At the start of their turn, they lose HP.
[gold]Decay[/gold] decreases by [blue]1/5[/blue] each turn.
AKI_SISTER_POWER_DRAIN_POWER.smartDescri:
Deal [blue]15%[/blue] less attack damage.
At the start of {OnPlayer:your turn|its turn}, lose [blue]{Amount}[/blue] HP.
At the end of {OnPlayer:your turn|its turn}, reduce [gold]Decay[/gold] by [blue]1[/blue].
AKI_SISTER_POWER_DRAIN_POWER.title: Decay
AKI_SISTER_POWER_WITHER_POWER.descriptio:
Creatures afflicted with [gold]Wither[/gold] take [blue]30%[/blue] more damage from attacks.
At the start of their turn, they lose HP.
[gold]Wither[/gold] decreases by [blue]1/5[/blue] each turn.

AKI_SISTER_POWER_AUTUMN_AURA_POWER.descr:
When you would lose HP from blockable damage, if you have enough [gold]Autumn Essence[/gold], prevent that HP loss and lose that much [gold]Autumn Essence[/gold] instead.
At the start of each turn, convert [blue]1/3[/blue] of your [gold]Autumn Essence[/gold] into [gold]Temporary Autumn Essence[/gold].
Whenever [gold]Autumn Essence[/gold] is reduced, apply [gold]Wither[/gold] equal to half the amount reduced to a random enemy.

AKI_SISTER_POWER_FRAGRANCE_POWER.descrip:
When you would take attack damage, if your [gold]Block[/gold] is less than the incoming damage, lose [gold]Fragrance[/gold] equal to the difference and gain that much [gold]Block[/gold].
At the start of each turn, convert [blue]1/3[/blue] of your [gold]Fragrance[/gold] into [gold]Temporary Fragrance[/gold].
Whenever [gold]Fragrance[/gold] is reduced, apply [gold]Decay[/gold] equal to half the amount reduced to a random enemy.
